text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとセシルは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Cecil are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとセシルは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Cecil are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp: いままでの自分を乗り越える
text.official_en: Do what must be done to face new challenges.
text.real_en: Overcome the person you used to be.

text.jp:
けれどセシルは、暗黒騎士だった自分の
責任を忘れませんでした。
text.official_en: Cecil, however, chose to both <text style="italic">live</> in the present <text style="italic">and</> with his past.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp: それでも世界のために戦う
text.official_en: Continue to fight on behalf of the world.

text.jp: それでも王に逆らえない
text.official_en: Obey the king at all cost.
text.real_en: Still be unable to defy the king.

text.jp: それは、ふたつの月が見守る異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this world, twin moons hung in the sky, overlooking the land.

text.jp:
それは過去と向き合ったセシルと同じ決意。
兄弟は想いを共に戦い、世界を守ったのです。
text.official_en: Despite the grave sins he committed in the past, Golbez atoned for them when he risked his life to aid Cecil in saving the world from Zemus.
text.real_en: He showed the same resolve as Cecil, who had faced his own past. The brothers fought together to protect the world.

text.jp:
そんなふたりが、剣を交えることになると
誰が想像できたでしょうか……。
text.official_en: Alas, the strength of their bond made their eventual clash all the more sorrowful.
text.real_en: Who could have imagined that those two would one day cross swords?

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ふたつの月が見守る異界の幻影　セシル
闇から光へ、優しき月のごとく夜を照らす。
text.official_en:
Dusk to Dawn Cecil
The former captain who brought gently glowing light to the dead of night.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision watched by two moons: Cecil. From darkness to light, he shines gently through the night like the moon.

text.jp:
やがてセシルたちの前に、戦乱をもたらす
魔道士ゴルベーザが立ちはだかります。
text.official_en: Eventually, Cecil’s party was beset by a powerful mage named Golbez, who sought to sow discord in the realm.

text.jp:
セシルの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
セシルは、あやまちを認めたゴルベーザや
カインを責めず、手を取り合いました。
text.official_en: No one can always be right, and Cecil was quick to forgive Golbez and Kain when they recognized their wrongs.
text.real_en: Cecil did not blame Golbez or Kain after they acknowledged their mistakes. He joined hands with them instead.

text.jp:
セシルは、暗黒騎士だった自分の
幻影を打倒し、過去と決別しました。
text.official_en: By facing his inner demons, Cecil was able to put his past behind him and focus on the problems that stood before him.
text.real_en: Cecil defeated a vision of his former self as a dark knight and broke with his past.

text.jp:
世界を混乱させた宿敵が
生き別れの兄だったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were it revealed that your archnemesis—who plunged the world into chaos—is also your sibling, what would you do?
text.real_en: If the enemy who had plunged the world into chaos turned out to be your long-lost older brother... what would you do?

text.jp:
主君が間違っていると思っても、
すぐに縁を切れないこともあります。
text.official_en: Even should you disagree with your monarch, the decision to sever your ties may not be so simple.

text.jp:
他人など信じないほうが楽でしょうか。
けれどセシルは、信じようとしました。
text.official_en: When Cecil’s best friend Kain stood against him, however, he chose to trust Kain rather than lay him low.
text.real_en: Perhaps it would be easier not to trust anyone. But Cecil tried to trust others anyway.

text.jp: 何を言っても信じない
text.official_en: Refuse to believe such tripe.
text.real_en: Refuse to believe anything they say.

text.jp:
侵略者だった自分が、聖なる騎士になれるか
セシルも迷ったことでしょう。
text.official_en: Cecil too had doubts about himself: could someone with his sordid past champion that which is holy?

text.jp: 信頼できる友と旅立つ
text.official_en: Embark on a journey with a trusted friend.

text.jp:
国を離れたセシルは、戦火に苦しむ人々を
助けることで、やるべきことを悟ります。
text.official_en: Had Cecil not left his homeland and seen the war from a different perspective, he may never have realized what he must do.
text.real_en: After leaving his country, Cecil helped people suffering from the war and realized what he had to do.

text.jp:
地位をなくして自由な立場になれば
新たに視野が広がるものです。
text.official_en: Such an experience can be a blessing in disguise, as it is an opportunity to broaden your horizons.

text.jp:
孤児だったセシルは、育ててくれた王に
恩があったのです。
text.official_en: For Cecil, having been raised by the king after he was orphaned, he was indebted to his liege.

text.jp:
宿敵ゴルベーザとセシルは
月の民の血をひく、兄弟だったのです。
text.official_en: There he discovered he and Golbez are brothers, and both are of Lunarian blood.

text.jp:
対抗する力を求め、暗黒騎士だったセシルは
聖なる騎士パラディンをめざします。
text.official_en: Though Cecil was trained specifically as a dark knight, in order to dispatch this new threat, he vowed to become a paladin.

text.jp:
彼の名は、セシル……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That former captain’s name is Cecil, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.

text.jp:
彼は任務を果たしたものの、王に疑問を
のべたことで、隊長の座を追われます。
text.official_en: Though the captain did as he was told, he questioned the king’s intentions, for which the king relieved him of his command.

text.jp:
彼らの旅は、青き星を飛び立って月の世界に
たどりつき……そして、ある事実が。
text.official_en: After surviving numerous trials and tribulations, Cecil journeyed away from his planet and toward one of its twin moons...
text.real_en: His journey took him from the Blue Planet to the world of the moon... where a startling truth awaited him.

text.jp: 心を改めれば許す
text.official_en: Forgive them if they are willing to repent.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp: 新しい立場を受け入れる
text.official_en: Make the best of the situation.
text.real_en: Accept your new position.

text.jp:
暗黒騎士の過去を背負う彼だからこそ
人の改心を、優しく受け入れたのでしょう。
text.official_en: Perhaps Cecil owes his prodigious largesse, at least in part, to the fact that he lives with his own dark past.

text.jp:
犯した罪から逃げず、向き合う姿勢こそ
パラディンにふさわしい気高さです。
text.official_en: Yet reflecting on his past, rather than shying from it, is as worthy a trait of a paladin as any.

text.jp: 生まれ変わって昔は忘れる
text.official_en: Forget the past.
text.real_en: Be reborn and forget the past.

text.jp:
真の敵ゼムスにあやつられていたゴルベーザは
命をかけて抗い、あやまちをつぐないました。
text.official_en: Though the decision to fight one of your kin is never an easy one to make, it led to Golbez’s mind being freed from Zemus’s grasp.
text.real_en: Golbez had been controlled by Zemus, the true enemy. He risked his life to resist and atone for his mistakes.

text.jp: 自分にできるか悩む
text.official_en: Wonder how possible it is to change.

text.jp:
自分の意見を語ったせいで
王の信用を失い、地位を奪われたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to lose both your station and the trust of your monarch, all for merely expressing your opinion on a matter, how would you proceed?

text.jp:
親友だと信じていたのに裏切られた、
そんな経験がセシルにもあります。
text.official_en: Understandable, as it can be exceedingly difficult to trust someone who is willing to strike you down.
text.real_en: Cecil, too, had been betrayed by someone he believed was his closest friend.

text.jp:
過去のあやまちは消せなくとも、
真正面から向き合うことはできます。
text.official_en: Though it may not be possible to erase the past, it <text style="italic">is</> possible to confront it.

text.jp:
過去は忘れて、現在を生きる。
それもひとつの生き方です。
text.official_en: To live in the present and not dwell on the past is certainly a valid choice.

text.jp:
道を見失ったとき、頼りになるのは友。
セシルも親友の竜騎士カインと任務に出ます。
text.official_en: When you have lost your way, who can you look to for guidance if not your friends? Fortunately for Cecil, he had Kain to accompany him.
text.real_en: When you lose your way, you can rely on a friend. Cecil, too, set out on a mission with his close friend Kain, a dragoon.

text.jp:
闇の騎士から、光の騎士へ。
真逆の生き方を選ぶことになったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you in his position and forced to walk a new path—one that runs counter to every tenet you hold—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you had to choose an utterly different way of life, from a knight of darkness to a knight of light... what would you do?

text.jp:
飛空艇団「赤い翼」の隊長をつとめる彼は、
王の命令で他国を襲い、クリスタルを奪いました。
text.official_en: Under their gaze, a king ordered the captain of his airship fleet—the Red Wings—to invade a neighboring country and divest it of its crystal.
text.real_en: As captain of the Red Wings airship fleet, he attacked another nation on his king’s orders and stole its Crystal.
